i_p1: Inside her office, Olga lay on her chair, her arms covering her eyes. Now there were a lot of things running through her mind right now.
i_p2: First the Singularities. Because of Lev and this mysterious King of his, the outside world is completely gone and Chaldea is the only stronghold to remain standing. It's also because of him that the 47 master candidates are in critical condition and only 20 staff members are alive. She couldn't believe this happened.
i_p3: Why? Why did he do this? How could he betray Chaldea like this? How could betray HER like this!?
i_p4: To her, she saw Lev as family. Ever since her father committed suicide, he's always been there for her. She trusted nobody but him. She relied on him because he always saved her when she needed him. Nobody has ever acknowledged her except for him. But now she knows the truth. It was nothing but a lie. He never cared about her. He psychologically manipulated her to be dependent on him which created a barrier between her and everyone else, including those who wanted to be friends with her.
i_p5: Now thanks to his betrayal, nearly all her staff members are gone, the 47 master candidates are nearly dead and the world is almost ending. What also made the betrayal hurt even worse was that he killed her. He destroyed her body and her mind was the only thing that managed to get Rayshifted and he tried to make her experience an endless death by trying to put her into CHALDEAS.
i_p6: That is until he saved her.
i_sora1: Sora : Are you done rambling? Because right now, I can tell you that you're wrong.
i_p7: She can hear his voice as he spoke to Lev.
i_sora2: Sora : No matter how deep the darkness is, there will always be a small glimmer of light! Well guess what? Chaldea is that light and it's thanks to Olga that it's still here to prevent the world from incinerating!
i_p8: His words were strong, firm and powerful. Like a hero from a fairy tale she once read as a child.
i_sora3: Sora : As long as Chaldea still stands…as long as we still stand, humanity and the future will not be incinerated! We will keep fighting to the very end and make sure the people of this world have a future to look forward to!
i_p9: Olga spoke his name softly. She still remembered what he did to her. After he used that…Keyblade on her, she felt like she was sleeping.
i_p10: Not sleeping as though she died, but sleeping like she was in bed or something. So you can imagine her surprise when she woke up with a brand new body and everyone around looking quite happy or relieved to see her again with some of the staff even crying.
i_p11: Once she made sure she wasn't dreaming and was in fact awake, all she could was cry.
i_p12: Cry in joy that she was truly alive and well but also in pain because of the evil heartless things that Lev had done. While she continued to cry, Da Vinci and Romani escorted her to her office and she never left as she continued to cry her emotions out.
i_p13: The following day, Romani and Da Vinci came in with a plate of breakfast for her and reports of what's been happening while she was away. She ate breakfast first and decided to read the first report on what happened after Singularity F. Once that was done, she read a report that depicted Sora's situation and the whole story of what brought him here.
i_p14: Now that got her completely floored as she couldn't believe what she read on Sora's story and the overall history of his universe.
i_p15: She just…no words could describe how amazed she was after she was finished reading everything about Sora and his universe.
i_p16: The forces of light and darkness. The Keyblade. The Keyblade War. Other worlds. Heartless. Nobody. Unversed. The seven Princesses of Heart. Organization 13. The Realms of Light, Darkness and Between. Master Xehanort.
i_p17: And most of all…Kingdom Hearts and its counterpart the original χ-blade.
i_p18: Olga removed her arms from her face as she said in amazement.
i_olga2: Olga : Kingdom Hearts…to think that something as incredible as that actually exists in Sora's universe. And the Keyblade…
i_p19: This is bad. This is very very bad!
i_p20: If the Mage Association catches wind of this incredible information then Sora's life will forever be in danger as long as he's here. Some will see Sora as a threat and will have him killed if he isn't under their control. Others will try and use him with empty promises of trying to help him get home. The rest will even try and find some way to get Keyblades of their own!
i_p21: Some families will definitely have Sora marry their daughters (or maybe even the female mages themselves) so that they can have his children and start a Keyblade lineage without his consent or say so. In fact, according to Xehanort, he called those who are descended from Keyblade wielders a 'blue blood'.
i_p22: She wouldn't even be surprised if the ancient Keyblade wielders had a similar social class system during this "Age of Fairy Tales". After all, there were a lot of them, but now the numbers have dwindled greatly. As far as she knew, Sora and most of his friends are considered to be the current generation of Keyblade wielders.
i_p23: It's already amazing enough that the Keyblade allows one to use True Magic, but being able to open any kind of lock in existence, including the hearts of a person or world, open gates to other worlds, changing its form into others weapons.
i_p24: The limitless potential of the Keyblade is remarkable! A true Mystery that the Association will want to learn more about and will attempt to acquire for themselves.
i_p25: Hell, the Association is already filled with rivalry between families and there's a lot of bad blood happening between certain people. So if they were able to get Keyblades of their own…then forget about a Holy Grail War, this world is gonna have its very first Keyblade War and will end up sharing the fate as Sora's world once did a very long time ago!
i_p26: She wouldn't even be surprised if there would be someone crazy enough to try and find a way to get to Sora's world in order to get Kingdom Hearts and its χ-blade. Or at least try and make their own Kingdom Hearts!
i_p27: Just like Xehanort and his counterparts did.
i_p28: She's going to have to protect Sora from the Association. Failure to be a Master or not, she's still one of the twelve Lords of the Clock Tower and the head of the Animusphere family.
